deliberate_differences: measured absolute entry-time difference without legal cutoff

evidence_review.uncovered: All exact cases; evidence.json contains zero accepted recordings.

observations: source-backed same statutory median-opening crossing and two different highways
Native stop-sign trigger/face, official status and governed entrance
complete original-frame body entry times and ego/right-side approach geometry
other traffic and any stop/yield response
official-device exclusion and opposite-direction left-turn exception
runtime_uncertainties: An official stop sign ordinarily activates the statutory official-device exclusion; measured near-time entry is not a NRS 484B.250(2) violation finding.
Native trigger and camera view alone do not establish official status or properly erected governance.
Approximately same time has no invented legal numeric cutoff.
Median opening needs source-backed one-crossing and spacing determination.
Exact runner, cameras, finalizer, fallbacks and proofs remain worker-owned CPU work.
planning_status: partial; Native stop-sign governance and original-frame entry timing/right-side geometry CPU-tested

entry_timing_landmark_cpu_proof.scope: Five-frame synthetic original-shaped rows test body-entry measurement and frame joins across before/equal/after landmarks; no legal simultaneity cutoff or Native response claimed
entry_timing_landmark_cpu_proof.remaining: Bind controller-feasible variants to exact construction, compatibility, recorded-only saved processing and independent source audit before marking the proposal sweep expanded

controller_release_axis_cpu_proof.observed: Other Native brake commands hold before each exact release frame and throttle starts at that frame; ego command traces are identical across the two variants.
controller_release_axis_cpu_proof.scope: Static fake actors prove control timing and independent ego commands, not motion, actual body-entry time or legal judgment.
controller_release_axis_cpu_proof.remaining: Run exact dynamically realized timing variants through source-bound compatibility, recorded-only saved processing, independent audit and canonical sweep expansion.

canonical_control_binding_cpu_proof.scope: Selected cases bind executable other-release frame 40; separated case binds executable eight-frame ego hold. First timing sweep specifies 32/40/48 control setpoints and remains incomplete pending exact expanded cases and source-bound proofs.

kinetic_surrogate_timing_cpu_proof.scope: A simplified CPU kinetic surrogate applies actual step_pair commands and generates original-shaped crossing_history/video_frames rows consumed by simultaneous_entries.analyze; this verifies controller-to-measurement wiring, not CARLA dynamics, source-backed compatibility or statutory approximate-time judgment.
kinetic_surrogate_timing_cpu_proof.remaining: Build exact sweep-point delivery cases, run their source-bound compatibility and recorded-only saved processing, audit independent evidence, and expand all four judgment sweeps.

yield_hold_axis_cpu_proof.scope: Simplified CPU kinetic surrogate applies step_pair commands and analyzes original-shaped frame-joined body histories. It validates post-clear hold-to-body-entry measurement wiring, not actual CARLA motion or legal yield.
yield_hold_axis_cpu_proof.remaining: Build exact 0/8/16 sweep-point delivery cases and source-bound compatibility, recorded-only saved processing and independent audit before expanding judgment sweeps.

turn_trajectory_cpu_audit.limitations: The retained three-frame synthetic source records intent and entry but no exit. A realized left turn and statutory exception are unresolved; positive and right-exit synthetic test variants only test the classifier.
